title: inventory.reservation.created — Payload Schema
description: Emitted by erp.inventory when a reservation request (triggered by order.placed) is accepted and a reservation is created. Commerce must transition the order from pending_reservation to reservation_active. erp.inventory will also emit a corresponding inventory.stock.updated message that reflects the new aggregate_available after this reservation.

reservation_id.description: Stable identifier for this reservation, generated by erp.inventory. Unique per reservation. Used in all subsequent lifecycle events for this reservation.

order_id.description: Identifier of the Commerce order that triggered this reservation via order.placed.

product_id.description: Stable product identifier from ERP Core.

location_id.description: Location from which the units are reserved. Per ADR-004.

quantity.description: Number of units reserved. Always a positive integer.

ttl_expires_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which this reservation will expire automatically if not confirmed. Derived from the reservation_policy TTL for the payment method of the originating order. Per ADR-003.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the reservation was committed in ERP Core.
